# Superstars Contracting — Python dependencies
# Generated by scanning all .py files in the codebase for third-party imports.
# Standard library modules (sqlite3, pathlib, json, etc.) are part of Python itself
# and are not listed here.
#
# Install on workstation with:
#   pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# Recommended: do this inside a virtual environment to keep deps isolated:
#   python -m venv venv
#   venv\Scripts\activate
#   pip install -r requirements.txt

# Web framework
flask>=3.0
flask-cors>=4.0

# Production WSGI server for Windows (continuous-run task — see run_server.ps1).
# Falls back to Flask's dev server if waitress isn't installed.
waitress>=3.0

# PDF generation (HTML → PDF)
weasyprint>=60.0

# Spreadsheet read/write (used by report generators)
openpyxl>=3.1

# Data manipulation (used by lookahead/meeting generators)
pandas>=2.0

# HTTP client (used by test scripts + future API integrations)
requests>=2.31

# Email sending (used by RFI/meeting workflows)
sendgrid>=6.11

# Image handling — iPhone face photos arrive as HEIC and browsers can't
# render them; we convert HEIC → JPEG server-side on face-photo upload.
# Pillow is the engine; pillow-heif adds HEIC codec support to it.
Pillow>=11.0
pillow-heif>=1.3

# Password hashing for dashboard auth (users table). Per-user salt, no
# plaintext passwords on disk. Worker-app PIN path is unaffected — workers
# don't get accounts.
bcrypt>=4.0
